texts.zh:
造成[From.GetName]日冕发现的恒星辐射共振的原因证明是一种可以耐受高温的异常晶体阵列。

在把这些晶体带到船上后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]震惊地发现这些怪异的共振是可以复现的。首先，他们将这些晶体暴露在与[From.GetName]相同的恒星辐射中，产生了与最初记录的现象完全一致的结果。它也似乎制造了我们发送给它的所有能量波的共振，形成了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]没有观测过的新的色彩和声音！

这种频率可以改变我们对宇宙的认知方式。换句话说，我们可以用一个晶态结构开发研究设备，使其能承受恒星级的超高热量。
texts.en:
The cause of the solar radiation resonance observed around the corona of [From.GetName] turned out to be an unusual crystal formation capable of enduring the heat!

Having brought the crystal aboard, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were startled to realize that the strange resonance was reproducible. First, they exposed the crystal to the same solar radiation from [From.GetName], producing an identical result to the initially recorded phenomenon. It also seemed to create resonances with all energy waves we sent through it, forming new colors and sounds never before observed by [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Such frequencies could change the way we view the universe. Alternatively, we can develop research applications for a crystalline structure capable of surviving the intense heat of a star.

label.en: Retrieve these new frequencies for further analysis.

label.en: Harvest the crystal to insulate our energy weapons.

# 怪异共鸣 / A Strange Resonance

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:527-548` · `events/anomaly_events_4.txt:1574-1692 (6740)` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4946-4957`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 2级异常；在没有战略资源的K型或M型恒星上权重1；null_spawn_chance 0.6（选中后40%真正生成）。  
  Level-2 anomaly; weight 1 on K/M stars without strategic resources; null_spawn_chance 0.6 (40% actually spawn).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 6740“科学之色”：日冕中耐高温的共振晶体（设置 colorscience_divination_flag，给予标本）。交给艺术家（非格式塔，50年艺术修正）/ 进一步分析（格式塔，50年研究修正），两者都加4物理资源点；或采集晶体用于能量武器（未拥有伽马激光时，给下一级激光进度）。  
  6740 "The Color of Science": a heat-proof resonant crystal (sets colorscience_divination_flag; specimen). Send the frequencies to artists (non-gestalt; 50-year modifier) or analyse them (gestalt), both adding +4 physics; or harvest it for energy weapons (next laser tech progress, if Gamma Lasers unknown).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 相关：colorscience_divination_flag 可在虚境行者“占卜之所”局势中解锁关于此晶体的事件（enclave.5180，另一故事）。  
  Related: colorscience_divination_flag enables a Shroudwalker divination event (enclave.5180, another story).

  No notable variants.
